notes.title: The Dead Rooms DEMO
notes.content:
[h1][b]V.30.00.24 DEMO[/b][/h1]
You've be moved into the  T̤̦̰̟͉̰̔͐ͫ͘ͅͅh̜̝̭̥̮ͩ̔ͬ̚͟ę̥̯͓̣ͧ͗ͧ ̯̗̝͇̮̗͉̒̍͘D̷͚̙̖͎̖̥͖̣̃̓̑ę̖̰ͣ͑a͍͖͚̤̬ͥ́͆̄͞d̵͕̻̜͚͍̻̱ͯ ͉̞͔̌ͯͩ̾́R̶̬͉͍̭̰̰̻͐ò͇͖̪̫͚̤̹͍̽ͯ͡ő̵͈͍̦͇͔̦m̢̗͉ͥ͊̂s̘̘͕̲̙͙͕͉͋̇͋̓͢. 

An FPS horror experience with Roguelike elements sprinkled in.

The [b][u]Demo Version[/u][/b] will offer a simplistic [i]stripped down[/i] version of the full game, featuring but not limited to:
[list]
[*]
3 floors [random/procedurally made]
pickups/consumables
First level skills available
4 playable classes
[/list]
[b]Full game[/b] should be ready within the week, and will be featuring 
[list]
[*]
FPS mechanics (Guns/enemy entities)
More floors
Perma-death mechanics
+more
[/list]

notes.title: The Dead Rooms DEMO Is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]DEMO v 30[/b][/h1]
Try the Demo for [b]free[/b]!, this will  contain the base [u]immersive mechanics[/u] of the game to give you a taste of whats coming..full version will include [b]more rooms, weapons, FPS mechanics, Rouge Like Mechanics,  replay ability, more skills[/b] ect. if you like what you see [b][u]WISHLIST [/u][/b]to be alerted when the full release is available.


Consider this the "lite" version of the full game.

notes.title: THE DEAD ROOMS!
notes.content:
The Dead Rooms aims to make an actually game out of the Back Rooms, [b]not just an immersive experience[/b]. A survival/roguelite TDR will challenge your survival!
CHECK out the store page for more information on what to expect!
